behavior: An item left blocked with every blocker cleared returns to open on the next re-check sweep tick.
falsifier: The after-tick dev:pg_query count on the live database still finds an item whose blockers are all cleared, with no other hold, in state blocked.

reading.definition: status='blocked', not observation lane, nature work, payload.externalBlockers a non-empty array with no element status='active' (every blocker cleared). sql: WITH c AS (SELECT w.workspace_id, w.feature_id, w.origin, w.source_plan_slug, w.state_changed_at, w.payload, (SELECT max(COALESCE(b->>'clearedAt', b->>'updatedAt')::timestamptz) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.payload->'externalBlockers') b) AS last_clear FROM harness_shared.work_items w WHERE w.status = 'blocked' AND w.lane IS DISTINCT FROM 'observation' AND COALESCE(w.nature,'work') = 'work' AND jsonb_typeof(w.payload->'externalBlockers') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(w.payload->'externalBlockers') > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.payload->'externalBlockers') b WHERE b->>'status' = 'active')), k AS (SELECT c.*, (state_changed_at > last_clear) AS reblocked_after_clear, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM harness_shared.work_item_deps d WHERE d.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND (d.blocked_ref = c.feature_id OR d.blocked_ref LIKE '%#' || c.feature_id)) AS has_dep_edge, ((COALESCE(payload->>'_claimHold','') = 'true' AND COALESCE(payload->>'held_open_reason','') <> 'blocked') OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(payload->>'claim_hold_by','')),'') IS NOT NULL) AS has_park, (payload->>'needsOwnerAction' = 'true' OR payload->>'needsHuman' = 'true') AS owner_reserved, (origin <> 'local') AS non_local, (source_plan_slug IS NOT NULL) AS plan_item FROM c) SELECT count(*) AS all_cleared_blocked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE reblocked_after_clear) AS reblocked_after_clear, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state_changed_at IS NULL OR last_clear IS NULL) AS missing_times, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reblocked_after_clear AND (has_dep_edge OR has_park OR owner_reserved OR non_local OR plan_item)) AS other_hold, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reblocked_after_clear AND NOT (has_dep_edge OR has_park OR owner_reserved OR non_local OR plan_item) AND last_clear < timestamptz '2026-10-21T01:40:02Z') AS falsifying_stranded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reblocked_after_clear AND NOT (has_dep_edge OR has_park OR owner_reserved OR non_local OR plan_item) AND last_clear >= timestamptz '2026-10-21T01:40:02Z') AS cleared_after_last_tick, now() AS measured_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM harness_shared.audit_log a WHERE a.actor = 'system:blocker-stranded-repair') AS repair_audit_rows FROM k
